entities.name: Q89ZW9
observations: Exact sequence match to the 419-residue query protein; reviewed UniProt entry from Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron annotates it as glycosyl hydrolase family 109 protein 2.
Binds one tightly associated NAD(+) cofactor per subunit.
Contains Pfam GFO_IDH_MocA (PF01408.29; residues 21–144) and Glyco_hydro_109_C (PF21252.4; residues 156–416).

entities.name: Q5LGW9
observations: Reviewed Bacteroides fragilis homolog with 79.4% identity and 98.6% query coverage; annotated as alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase, EC 3.2.1.49, requiring tightly bound NAD(+).

entities.name: Query protein
observations: Length 419 amino acids; calculated molecular mass 47.3 kDa; theoretical pI 6.13.
Best reference is an exact sequence match to Q89ZW9, supporting glycoside hydrolase family 109 function.

Likely cleaves non-reducing alpha-(1→3)-linked N-acetylgalactosamine residues from blood-group A/Forssman-related glycoconjugates; exact substrate specificity is supported by a 79.4%-identity homolog and should be treated as highly probable.
Likely participates in microbial degradation of host and dietary glycans, especially terminal alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminyl residues.

entities.name: Glycan degradation
observations: The protein's glycosidase activity is consistent with carbohydrate catabolism and breakdown of complex host-associated glycoconjugates in Bacteroides.
